# openinfra_email_sender (Resource)

Transactional email sending — the AWS SES-shaped primitive. Provisions a sending identity (a From address) and emits a `<name>-smtp` connection secret (SMTP host/port/from) apps consume via `spec.secrets` -> envFrom. Backed by the shared in-cluster SMTP relay; rides the opt-in `mail` component. Experimental — internet deliverability needs a smarthost/SPF/DKIM.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `from_address` (String) The sending identity — the From address, e.g. `noreply@example.com`.
- `name` (String) Resource name. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `from_name` (String) Optional display name for the From header.
- `namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `namespace/name`, the import identifier.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the resource's Ready condition is True. Terraform returns as soon as the object is accepted, so this is usually `false` immediately after apply — the platform reconciles asynchronously.
